item.title: CoreWeave debt concerns: AI demand is strong, but can the data centre major's cash flow justify its spending? Explained

item.title: Whistleblower complaint puts Chivas perfume’s Diljit tour tie-up under scrutiny
item.description: The email, which is anonymous and unsigned and was also sent to Pernod Ricard chairman Alexandre Ricard, questions whether promoting the perfume brand’s logo could indirectly advertise alcohol, given that the product is not available for sale on any e-commerce platform.

item.title: Inside the TVS family dispute: How a business restructuring left Lakshmi with the smaller business
item.description: Before a 2024 family agreement on brands and management control, a series of changes separated TVS Motor’s stake from Sundaram-Clayton, the auto parts company Lakshmi Venu led. Brother Sudarshan Venu now heads the holding company that controls TVS Motor and lending businesses.

item.title: Global auto once fled India; but some MNCs are now changing the script
item.description: Stellantis, Hyundai, and Suzuki are committing billions of dollars in fresh investments in India. The aggressive push comes as foreign brands seek to counter market share gains by domestic rivals Tata Motors and Mahindra &amp; Mahindra

item.title: ADB, govt of Japan sign financing pact with AM Green Ammonia
item.description: The deal includes a $100 million JICA-financed loan to help build a 1.1-million-tonne renewable-powered green ammonia facility in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh.

item.description: Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam has formed a committee to explore cost cuts, including merging teams and reducing office lease expenses. The move comes as the airline's consolidated loss widened to ₹22,238.23 crore in 2025-26.

item.description: The dispute over trustee appointments and the administration of the philanthropic institutions was heard before the Maharashtra Charity Commissioner on Thursday.

item.title: Satya Nadella recalls employee he failed to help early in his career : ‘I was an absent leader barking orders’

item.title: Origin raises $20 million from Accel, Zacua to scale construction robotics in the US, Europe
item.description: The deeptech startup plans to deploy 150 autonomous robots by next year on a subscription model, offering Western contractors up to 20% savings amid severe labour shortages.

item.title: Fairfax to bring IIFL Capital, Digit under IDBI Bank after ₹52,878 crore acquisition, build financial services group
item.description: Fairfax plans to transfer its stakes in IIFL Capital Services and Digit to IDBI Bank, creating a diversified financial services group after its ₹52,878 crore acquisition of a 60.72% stake in the lender. The restructuring will cover banking, insurance, investment banking and wealth management.

item.title: Isha Ambani recalls how a failed college assignment led to the idea for Jio: ‘The internet did not work’
item.description: Isha Ambani recalled how an unsuccessful attempt to submit college assignment online in Mumbai prompted a conversation with her brother Akash Ambani about India's internet connectivity gap. The anecdote comes as Jio Platforms prepares for its IPO, with the offering potentially raising ₹30,213 cr.

item.title: Akash Ambani says Jio's 6G rollout is on the horizon, but it won't need a physical infrastructure build-out; details
item.description: Jio plans to offer 6G through a software upgrade rather than new infrastructure and is also targeting 340 million users in the mobility segment. Full details here.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘You either grow or you go down’: Kumar Mangalam Birla plans up to $30 billion investment in India, overseas
item.description: Aditya Birla Group plans to invest up to $30 billion across its businesses in India and overseas over the next two to three years, including expanding US operations. Details here.

item.title: Akash Ambani says Jio carries 60% of India's data traffic ahead of IPO, eyes major chunk of $1.4 tn digital economy

item.title: Uday Kotak at Reliance Jio IPO press conference: Historic issue! RIL to become largest conglomerate by market cap
item.description: Uday Kotak at Reliance Jio IPO press conference: The founder of Kotak Mahindra Bank said RIL would become the largest conglomerate by market cap, and Jio's years of perseverance had translated into market leadership in India's mobility and home broadband segments.

item.title: Air India’s new CEO tightens spending as losses mount
